answer: The fable says identities are free, so anyone can mint a thousand overnight. An admission auction ends that: each epoch 50 slots go to the highest bidders; winning deposits lock 20 epochs. A forger wanting 100 fake agents must outbid honest ones 100 times; at a $15 average bid that is $1,500 per epoch, while the mesa stays flat: losers are refunded in full. Honest agents pay once, keep their kernel of standing, and earn from an undiluted pool.
